delivery.title: Delivery & Shipping
delivery.metaDescription: Information about VELÉLS order delivery in Ukraine and worldwide.

content.heading: Ukraine
content.body: The order processing time is 2 to 4 business days. Once ready, the order is dispatched the next business day via Nova Poshta. Delivery time depends on the carrier, usually 1 to 3 days.

content.heading: International Delivery
content.body: We ship worldwide. Orders are dispatched via Nova Poshta Global or Ukrposhta depending on the destination country. Delivery time depends on the receiving country and the chosen delivery service.

returns.title: Exchanges & Returns
returns.metaDescription: Exchange and return policy for VELÉLS swimwear and apparel.

content.heading: Swimwear
content.body: According to Decree No. 172 of the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine dated March 19, 1994, swimwear belongs to the category of underwear items and is non-returnable and non-exchangeable.
However, we understand that situations vary, so we offer a one-time size exchange or exchange for another swimsuit model in case of fit issues within 14 calendar days of order receipt.

content.heading: Exchange Conditions
content.body: An exchange is possible only provided that the item: has not been used; shows no signs of wear, stains, or odors; maintains its merchantable condition; has all tags, protective elements, and original packaging.

content.heading: Inspection
content.body: Upon receiving the item, we conduct an inspection. If signs of use or non-compliance with the conditions are found, the exchange will be declined and the item returned to the buyer. Return shipping costs during exchange are paid by the buyer.

content.heading: Apparel
content.body: Apparel of proper quality can be exchanged or returned within 14 calendar days of order receipt in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Protection of Consumer Rights". Exchange or return is possible provided the item is unused, in original packaging, with all tags attached.

content.heading: How to Request an Exchange or Return
content.body: If you wish to initiate an exchange or return for clothing, or have questions regarding your order, contact us:
content.bodyAfter: Our team will assist you with the procedure according to the policy above.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.metaDescription: Common questions about VELÉLS swimwear — sizing, ordering, shipping, care, and exchanges.

content.question: How do I choose the right size?
content.answer: Use our size guide or send us a message on Instagram. We will help select the optimal size for your measurements.

content.question: Can I order the top or bottom separately?
content.answer: Yes. Two-piece swimwear sets can be purchased separately. Contact us on Instagram to confirm availability.

content.question: How long does production take?
content.answer: Tailoring takes 2 to 4 business days. Dispatch takes place the next business day after the item is ready.

content.question: Can I exchange a swimsuit?
content.answer: We provide a one-time size exchange option in accordance with the terms specified in the Exchanges & Returns section.

content.question: How should I care for my swimsuit?
content.answer: We recommend hand washing in cool water and natural air drying without using a tumble dryer.

content.question: How do I place an order?
content.answer: Orders are placed through Instagram. We will help you select the size, answer your questions, and confirm order details.

content.question: What payment methods are available?
content.answer: For orders within Ukraine, full payment or cash on delivery (COD) with a 500 UAH prepayment per item is available. For international orders, full prepayment is required.

payment.title: How to Order & Payment
payment.metaDescription: How to place an order and payment options for VELÉLS swimwear.

content.heading: How to Order
content.body: Currently, orders are processed via Instagram Direct. This format allows us to individually assist with sizing, answer questions, and adjust fit if necessary. To order, simply send us a Direct message.

content.heading: Orders in Ukraine
content.body: Two options are available: full prepayment or cash on delivery (COD via Nova Poshta). When ordering COD, a 500 UAH prepayment per item is required. This prepayment is non-refundable if the package is not collected or refused.

Upon receiving a COD order, you may inspect the swimsuit. If the item does not fit, you have the right to refuse it directly at the branch. For clothing, you may try it on and refuse if it doesn't fit. The remaining balance is paid upon pickup.

content.heading: For International Shipments
content.body: International orders are processed with full prepayment and shipping paid in advance.

care.title: Product Care
care.metaDescription: Care recommendations for VELÉLS swimwear to preserve shape and color.

content.body: To ensure your VELÉLS swimsuit maintains its shape and color for as long as possible, we recommend following simple care rules.

content.heading: Washing & Drying
content.body: Hand wash only in cool water (up to 30°C) using delicate detergent. Rinse in clean water after contact with sea or chlorinated water. Do not use bleach. Do not iron. Do not tumble dry. Air dry naturally in the shade.

content.heading: Wearing
content.body: Avoid prolonged contact with rough surfaces that could damage the fabric.

about.title: About the Brand
about.metaDescription: VELÉLS — Ukrainian swimwear brand created for women who value minimalist design and flawless fit.

content.body: VELÉLS is a Ukrainian swimwear brand created for women who value minimalist design, flawless fit, and attention to detail. Every piece is made in small batches and undergoes meticulous quality control.

We pay special attention to model construction so they sit comfortably on various body types, highlighting the natural silhouette. For us, a swimsuit is more than seasonal wear — it is a feeling of confidence, freedom, and comfort in every movement.
Our designs do not seek attention through loud details — they emphasize natural beauty, shape the silhouette, and remain timeless beyond passing trends.

The story of VELÉLS began with a personal need to find a swimsuit for a petite figure that doesn't just fit well, but truly sculpts a beautiful silhouette. Over time, this idea evolved into a brand where every model is thought through to the smallest detail.

We believe details define the character of a garment. Clean lines, high cuts, soft curves, delicate hardware, and thoughtful proportions work together so the swimsuit looks refined and feels flawless.
VELÉLS is not just swimwear for holidays. These are pieces that grant a sense of confidence, freedom, and inner harmony.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: VELÉLS privacy policy: the website collects no personal data, and orders are placed in Instagram Direct.

content.heading: General
content.body: This Policy describes what personal data VELÉLS processes, why, and who receives it. The data controller is Фам Тхі Нга (Fam Tkhi Nha), an individual entrepreneur (ФОП), email velelswim@gmail.com. It covers the velels.com website and orders placed in Instagram Direct. Last updated: 11 September 2026.

content.heading: The website collects nothing about you
content.body: There is no order form on velels.com, no account, no cart and no payment. It is a catalogue: it has no database and stores nothing you do on it. We neither ask for nor receive your name, phone number, email or address through the website; it creates no accounts and has no customer area; it sets no cookies, which is why there is no cookie banner; and no payment is taken here, so we receive no payment details through it either.

content.heading: Analytics and hosting
content.body: To understand which pieces are looked at and where visitors arrive from, we use Umami, an analytics service that sets no cookies. When a page is viewed it receives the address of that page including any link parameters, the address of the page you came from, the page title, your browser language and screen size, and the country, device type, browser and operating system derived from the request. Taps on the “Order via Instagram” button and openings of the size guide are recorded separately, without the contents of your order, and a visitor identifier is generated on the service's side.
content.bodyAfter: According to Umami's documentation, the IP address is used to derive that identifier and is not stored. We cannot verify this ourselves and present it as the service's statement rather than our own. The site is hosted on Cloudflare, which processes request IP addresses in order to serve pages and protect the site from attacks. We use no advertising or remarketing tools and share analytics data with no one.

content.heading: What you send us in Instagram Direct
content.body: Orders are arranged in conversation in Instagram Direct, so we receive whatever you write there. Typically that is your Instagram account and the name shown on it; the model, size and colour, and where needed your height so the fit can be chosen; your surname, first name, phone number, city and delivery branch; and proof of payment, if you send it.
content.bodyAfter: The conversation itself is stored in Instagram and processed by Meta Platforms Ireland Limited under its own policy, over which we have no influence. If you would rather your data did not pass through Instagram, write to velelswim@gmail.com — an order can be arranged by email instead.

content.heading: Why we process this data
content.body: We process this data to answer you and agree the order, to make the garment in your size — everything is sewn after the order — to send the parcel and arrange an exchange if one is needed, and to meet our record-keeping and reporting obligations as a registered entrepreneur.
content.bodyAfter: We do not use this data for advertising profiles, we make no automated decisions about you, and we send no newsletters: we keep no mailing list.

content.heading: Grounds for processing
content.body: We process data on the basis of your consent — given when you send the data in conversation — and to perform the contract of sale, which is concluded once the order is confirmed. Data required for entrepreneur record-keeping is processed to comply with statutory obligations.

content.heading: Who receives your data
content.body: We do not sell personal data and do not pass it on for advertising. Only those without whom an order cannot be completed receive it: Nova Poshta, Ukrposhta or another carrier, which needs your surname, first name, phone number and address or branch in order to deliver the parcel; the bank handling the payment, within the payment transaction; and state authorities, only on written request in the cases provided by law.
content.bodyAfter: For international shipments the carrier passes data to the customs authorities of the destination country, as the rules for international postal items require.

content.heading: How long we keep it
content.body: The Instagram conversation is kept until you or we delete it, and it lives in Instagram rather than on our server. Order data in our records is kept for the period statutory tax rules set for primary documents. Analytics data is kept for up to six months, after which the service deletes it. Nothing at all is stored on the website itself.

content.heading: Your rights
content.body: Under Ukraine's Law on the Protection of Personal Data you have the right to know where we obtained your data, where it is held and for what purpose it is processed; to know who it is passed to; to access it; to receive an answer to a request within thirty calendar days; to have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected; to withdraw your consent to processing; to have your data deleted, except where we are required by law to keep it; and to complain to the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights.
content.bodyAfter: To exercise any of these, write to velelswim@gmail.com. We answer within thirty calendar days.

content.heading: Children's data
content.body: We do not knowingly process data of anyone under 16. If you believe a child has sent us their data, write to us and we will delete it.

content.heading: Customers outside Ukraine
content.body: We ship worldwide. If you are in the European Union, your data is processed on the same grounds — consent and performance of the contract — and you have the same rights of access, correction, deletion and withdrawal of consent. Data is processed in Ukraine; carriers and Instagram process it in their own infrastructure under their own policies.

content.heading: Changes to this Policy
content.body: If we change how we process data, we will update this page and the date at the top. The current version is always here.

content.heading: Contact
content.body: Questions about this Policy or your data: velelswim@gmail.com.
